description: DRAFT (TASK-0054/0055): calibration build of the jet slice, spec v0.27 §8.2; model JetSliceCalib. This manifest = the base point (§8.1 values) and the declaration of the whole calibration (grids, loss, stopping rule in meta). Stage points are in separate manifests that stay valid after each freeze: EXP-0002-c1.json (c1-stand), EXP-0002-c3c4.json, EXP-0002-c2.json. After the freeze: the control-tables run (§8.2 p.8) with all frozen values in 'params'. Not frozen.

meta.status: draft: every declared point of stages C3+C4 (phase A) and C2 is a series point here and runs with 'matrix'/'run --point'; C1 points are in EXP-0002-c1.json (c1-stand). Grids, order, loss and stopping rule declared before any evaluation (spec §8.2 p.4); C1/C2 grids are [Predl.] and need the Orchestrator's approval.
meta.stopping_rule: spec §8.2 p.4: points of a stage in the written order; stop at the first point with L_stage = 0; else the minimum L_stage (tie: the first in order); the stage's parameters are frozen and the next stage does not touch them; after C2 the total L over all anchors incl. C5. Budget exhausted with L > 0: no EXP, journal to the Orchestrator (p.7).

loss.distance: d_k = max(0, lo_k - s_k, s_k - hi_k) / (hi_k - lo_k); binary conditions d = 0 or 1; L = sum d_k^2, all weights 1 (spec §8.2 p.3)

statistics: C1e MATURE unit_cost fall <= 0.30 (one-sided, d = max(0, s - 0.30)/0.30)
C1.empty_set: d = 1 (DEV: no doubling with min yield >= 0.25)
C1.p0_not_loss: Wright: window mean of asm_over_floor_drop in [0.15; 0.30] (#187)

C3+C4.C3: median over the 11 star nodes of the CV of discovery months on the C3 stand (one actor, S = S_ref, c_n / k of the point), corridor [0.3; 0.5], 100 calibration seeds
C3+C4.C4: share of calibration seeds with the first G2/G3/G4 in service in 1947-52 / 1954-61 / 1967-75, corridor [0.5; 1]

statistics: p50 t_first -> t_07 of tier-4 star PRC in [2; 8] years (censored = +inf, lower median; > 50% of the pool without t_first -> d = 1)
tier-5 longer than tier-4 (binary; empty or fully censored tier-5 -> d = 1)

C1.status: [Predl.] TASK-0054; spec §8.1 'K' parameters that move the C1 stand: x_scale (X_half of tiers 3/4/5 x the factor, ratio 1:4:12.5 fixed) and alpha (culture growth, DEV only). DEV starts from an admitted prc_set (#231, spec v0.27 §8.2 p.1); min yield per doubling sits at the 0.25 filter, so print min_yield per doubling in the journal.
C1.order: x_scale outer, alpha inner, each in the listed order (the §8.1 / IndustryParams value first, then the nearer neighbours)

phase_B.when: only if no phase-A point has L_stage = 0
phase_B.at: the 3 best phase-A points by L_stage (tie: walk order)
phase_B.order: those points by rank, kappa ascending within
phase_B.runnable: appended to EXP-0002-c3c4.json by its meta.phase_B

C3+C4.choice: minimum L_stage over phases A and B (tie: the first in order, A before B)
C3+C4.edge: a minimum at k = 3 with d_C4 > 0 is not a reason to widen the grid inside the stage (p.7)

C2.status: [Predl.] TASK-0054; spec §8.1 'K' left for C2 after C1 and C3+C4: c_M (§8.1: 'K (C2)') and delta_H. delta_E has no anchor (C1 stand: X = line_E = N without forgetting; no other statistic reads it) - propose 'Z' at 0.025, like LR (v0.24).

meta.control_tables: after the freeze: exp0002.py --calib DIR --tables-out lab/manifests/control_tables-EXP-0002.json; control_tables_hash = sha256 of the file (format §3.1); A40 bands re-derived from the same run (spec A40 v0.26)
meta.stage_protocol: Stages run C1 -> C3+C4 -> C2, each from its own manifest. A stage's chosen K values are frozen into the top-level 'params' of the LATER stage manifests and of this one (for the control-tables run), each a revision with a new manifest_hash recorded in its 'journal'; a stage manifest sweeps only its own keys, so no frozen key is ever both a parameter and a sweep axis. Phase B of C3+C4: EXP-0002-c3c4.json meta.phase_B. Per point: 'matrix --manifest M --point P --out DIR' (the point's 100 seeds), then 'exp0002.py --calib DIR --point P'.
